name: What impact does whole-house window replacement have on home value?

mainEntity.name: What impact does whole-house window replacement have on home value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whole-house window replacement can significantly increase your home's value and appeal. New, energy-efficient windows improve curb appeal, reduce energy costs for heating and cooling, and enhance indoor comfort. They also offer improved sound insulation and security. While the exact return on investment varies, it's generally considered one of the home improvement projects that offer a strong return, often recouping a substantial portion of the cost at resale.
acceptedAnswer.description: New windows boost home value by improving curb appeal, reducing energy costs, enhancing comfort, and increasing security, offering a strong return on investment.
